title: Give the opt-out recovery refusal the enable-task-sync remedy when only completed history exists
outcome: Give the opt-out recovery refusal the enable-task-sync remedy when only completed history exists
acceptance: With task sync disabled and only completed preparation history (nothing pending), `task prepare` without --rebaseline is refused with a message that names the enable-task-sync remedy (the DISABLED_PREPARATION context), not only 'only the latest admitted pending preparation can recover after opt-out'.
A regression test covers that branch and asserts the exact refusal text and an unchanged store and filesystem.

completion.summary: Completed-only opt-out recovery now gives the enable-task-sync remedy while damaged pending journals retain their recovery refusal; regression coverage and the full gate passed.
